Google Sheets Integration Setup

Automatically creates 3 live breakdown tabs with totals & calculations.

Apps Script Code (Creates 3 Automated Sheet Tabs) 
function doGet() {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var sheet = ss.getSheetByName('Expenses') || ss.insertSheet('Expenses');
  var rows = sheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  var data = [];
  for (var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if(rows[i][0]) {
      data.push({
        id: String(rows[i][0]),
        date: String(rows[i][1]),
        title: String(rows[i][2]),
        amount: Number(rows[i][3]),
        paidBy: String(rows[i][4]),
        involved: String(rows[i][5]).split(',').map(function(s){return s.trim();}),
        createdBy: String(rows[i][6] || rows[i][4])
      });
    }
  }
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(data)).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  var ss = SpreadsheetApp.getActiveSpreadsheet();
  var expSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Expenses') || ss.insertSheet('Expenses');
  if (expSheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
    expSheet.appendRow(["ID", "Date", "Title", "Amount", "PaidBy", "Involved Members", "CreatedBy"]);
  }
  
  var req = JSON.parse(e.postData.contents);
  if (req.action === 'add') {
    expSheet.appendRow([req.id, req.date, req.title, req.amount, req.paidBy, req.involved.join(', '), req.createdBy]);
  } else if (req.action === 'delete') {
    var rows = expSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
    for (var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
      if (String(rows[i][0]) === String(req.id)) {
        expSheet.deleteRow(i + 1);
        break;
      }
    }
  }
  
  recalculateSheetTabs(ss);
  return ContentService.createTextOutput(JSON.stringify({status: "success"})).setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function recalculateSheetTabs(ss) {
  var members = ['Sai', 'Pavan', 'John', 'Rakesh', 'Praveen'];
  var expSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Expenses');
  var rows = expSheet.getDataRange().getValues();
  
  var totals = {};
  var shares = {};
  members.forEach(function(m) { totals[m] = 0; shares[m] = 0; });
  
  var grandTotal = 0;
  for (var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
    if(!rows[i][0]) continue;
    var amt = Number(rows[i][3]) || 0;
    var payer = String(rows[i][4]).trim();
    var inv = String(rows[i][5]).split(',').map(function(s){return s.trim();});
    
    grandTotal += amt;
    if(totals[payer] !== undefined) totals[payer] += amt;
    if(inv.length > 0) {
      var split = amt / inv.length;
      inv.forEach(function(m) {
        if(shares[m] !== undefined) shares[m] += split;
      });
    }
  }

  // Update "Member Totals & Balances" Tab
  var totSheet = ss.getSheetByName('Member Totals & Balances') || ss.insertSheet('Member Totals & Balances');
  totSheet.clear();
  totSheet.appendRow(["Member Name", "Total Paid (₹)", "Personal Share (₹)", "Net Balance (₹)", "Status"]);
  
  members.forEach(function(m) {
    var net = totals[m] - shares[m];
    var status = net > 0 ? "Gets Back ₹" + net.toFixed(2) : (net < 0 ? "Owes ₹" + Math.abs(net).toFixed(2) : "Settled");
    totSheet.appendRow([m, totals[m], shares[m], net, status]);
  });
  totSheet.appendRow(["GRAND TOTAL", grandTotal, grandTotal, 0, "-"]);
}

Steps to Link Google Sheet:

1. Open your Google Sheet > Extensions > Apps Script.

2. Paste the code above and click Deploy > New deployment.

3. Choose Web app | Execute as: Me | Who has access: Anyone.

4. Copy the Web app URL and paste it into the field above.
